title: Great product
text: Great product. These are great. I have attached them to the side of my cabinet and stored my bottle spices in them. They seal hold up well as I have four bottles of spices in each container. The spices are at my fingertip and I can see everything that I have. You can also store pens and pencils in them among many other things.

product_metadata.title: Command Medium Caddy, Clear, with 4 Clear Indoor Strips, Organize Damage-Free
features: ORGANIZE DAMAGE-FREE - Say goodbye to holes, marks, or sticky residue on your walls, doors, cabinets, or closets; Command Caddies by 3M are easy to use and help keep your walls looking beautiful
NO TOOLS REQUIRED- Organize spices and tea in the kitchen cabinet. Corral nail polishes and lipstick inside the vanity cabinet
STRONG AND VERSATILE- Command wall organizers hold strongly on a variety of smooth indoor surfaces such as painted walls, tile, finished wood, glass, and metal
REMOVES CLEANLY- Reorganize when inspiration strikes; These wall caddies leave no sticky adhesive behind; Perfect to use inside cabinets and closets, in your college dorm, apartment, home, and office
description: Command Clear Organization Products provide handy, stylish organization without wall damaging nails, screws, tacks or permanent adhesives. Using The Command Clear Adhesive Strips, they stick to many surfaces, including painted surfaces, wood, tile, metal and more. Yet, they also come off leaving no holes, marks, sticky residue or stains. No problem to move your Command Organization Products, just apply a Command Clear Refill Strip, so you can use them again and again! Available in a variety of shapes and sizes, Command Clear Organization Products help you keep everything in your dorm room, apartment, home and office in its place and organized!
